LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre -Technical Studies
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is Pre- Technical Studies important in day-to- day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies helps you succeed in PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

KEY FACTS: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Study Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area. You will use ideas from in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area.
2. Plan safely, do the steps, then check using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Safety first: State one safety rule before practising “Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies”.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life. You will use ideas from in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life.
2. Plan safely, do the steps, then check using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Steps: List 3 correct steps to complete a simple task on Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: State one safety rule before practising “Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies”. (skill: identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area)

Example 2: List 3 correct steps to complete a simple task on Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies. (skill: explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area.
3. Practise this skill: explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is Pre- Technical Studies important in day-to- day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area.
5. Be able to: explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
